tagline: Ask about developments, partner brands, locations and results. Every answer is grounded in public filings and reference sources, cited, dated and checked before you read it.

disclaimer: Information is indicative and taken from public sources on the dates shown. Prices, availability and terms change; confirm everything with the sales team. Nothing here is investment, legal or tax advice. Property advertising in Saudi Arabia is regulated by REGA and in Dubai by RERA.
footer: Independent technical demo. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any company mentioned.
privacy: Your questions are sent to a free third-party AI model that may retain them. Emails, phone numbers and ID numbers are removed before sending. Contact details you submit in the interest form are stored only for this demo, deleted after 90 days, and never sent to the AI model. This notice is written with UK GDPR and Saudi PDPL in mind but is not legal advice.

hero_title: Considered answers, drawn only from the record.

how_steps.d: Language, intent and the companies involved are detected; unsafe or manipulative input is stopped here.
Keyword search, multilingual semantic search and the knowledge graph each rank passages; the rankings are fused.
A free open model writes the answer from those passages only, with a citation after every fact.
Each sentence is checked against its sources, along with figures, citations, privacy and brand separation.

hosting_note: Hosted on {provider} ({plan} tier). After {minutes} minutes without visitors the server sleeps, and the first request can take up to {seconds} seconds while it wakes. A scheduled ping keeps it warm most of the time.
about_body: An independent technical demonstration of a grounded, bilingual retrieval system. Sources were collected politely from public pages whose robots.txt allows it; sites that put automated visitors behind bot checks were not worked around. Retrieval combines SQLite FTS5 keyword search, multilingual MiniLM embeddings and an evidence-backed entity graph, fused with reciprocal-rank fusion. Answers come from free OpenRouter models with automatic fallback, then pass through output guardrails before they are shown.
